purpose: English-translation candidate-generation rules for the dimension values of config/divinity_ontology.json. A match here is a CANDIDATE for a human coder, never an attestation. Patterns are matched after whitespace normalisation (re.sub(r'\s+',' ',text)), which v1 did not do and which cost it Isaiah 44:6 and Mark 12:29.

matching_conventions.normalisation: collapse all runs of whitespace to one space; keep original offsets in a separate map so locators stay exact
matching_conventions.word_boundary: every pattern is anchored with \b at both ends
matching_conventions.ambiguity_marker: rules whose hits need a human to choose between dimension values carry `disambiguation_needed` and are never auto-scored
matching_conventions.coverage_state: `instrumented` | `partially_instrumented` | `not_yet_instrumented` — a value is only eligible for the `not_attested_in_available_sources` state if it is `instrumented` AND every lexicon entry in the source languages associated with the work was searched

speech_act_markers.note: D7 is not detected by a term; it is detected by the shape of the window around the term. These markers run first and their output constrains which values the other dimensions may take. This ordering is deliberate: v1 read the term and inferred the doctrine, which is how a conditional became an atheist confession and Paul's 'one spirit' became monotheism.

conditional_hypothetical.constrains: D7=conditional_hypothetical; the contained negation is NOT an asserted doctrine

reported_speech.constrains: D7=reported_speech_of_opponent when the subject is human or an opponent

question.constrains: D7=doubt_or_inquiry; a question about divinity is not a denial of it

non_divine_speaker.constrains: D7=boast_of_non_divine_claimant when a first-person oneness formula follows

personal_agent.disambiguation_needed: pronoun antecedents cross passages; needs a window check

impersonal_principle.note: transliterated terms survive translation, so this value is the best-instrumented in the frame; that is an orthographic accident and must be reported as such

animating_substance.caution: each of these needs an informant-and-community check; `mana` collides with the plural of `man` and with ethnographic prose, which is why v1 rejected it

collective_or_class.disambiguation_needed: `the gods` is a class reference only when no single term is being exalted; pair with D2

unknowable_or_conceptless.reason: apophatic assertion is phrased as negation and is systematically stolen by the denial patterns; v1's `no god` family would have swallowed it whole. Requires the D7 apophatic rule to be authored and tested before this value can be scored.

undecidable.auto: assigned when no value's patterns match in a divine-reference window, or when two incompatible values match the same window

sole_existent_others_unreal.hard_rule: requires D7 in {asserted_doctrine, philosophical_argument} with a divine or prophetic speaker; otherwise the match belongs to another value or to `undecidable`. This rule is what the audit forced.

sole_worshipable_others_acknowledged.disambiguation_needed: `the lord is one` is a KJV substring collision: 1 Cor 6:17 'joined unto the Lord is one spirit' and 1 Ne 10:19 'course of the Lord is one eternal round' both match it and neither is a plurality claim. Never auto-score.
sole_worshipable_others_acknowledged.note: Deut 6:4's `eḥad` is contested between 'one' and 'alone'; the monolatrous and monotheistic readings sit in this value and the one above, and the English cannot arbitrate

none.hard_rule: requires D7 in {asserted_doctrine, philosophical_argument} with the denier as the text's own voice; a conditional, a question, an opponent's reported speech or an idol-polemic does NOT code as `none`. v1's 116 skepticism matches are mostly one of these four.

undecidable.auto: default when the window neither counts beings nor denies them

law_without_will.coverage_note: thin, and biased to traditions that were transliterated

reciprocal_dependency.coverage_note: thin; the strongest sources for this are ritual texts the corpus does not contain

non_agential.reason: collides with `law_without_will` and with Daoist and Upanishadic apophasis; needs a value-level disambiguation rule before use

guarding_localised.note: a local god is a D2 and D5 claim at once; this is why the value lives in function and the scope claim lives in D5

world_in_divine_not_exhausting.reason: the term is modern and scholarly; pre-modern texts express it by image, which this rule set cannot code

scale_not_claimed.reason: silence about the cosmos is not an assertion of locality; only explicit place-bound language codes here, and the corpus rarely supplies it in a translatable form

born_in_time.note: the Egyptian 'there was a time when the gods had not come into being' and Hesiod's Theogony both code here; v1 had no value that could hold either

D7_human_interpretation.assigned_by: speech_act_markers, evaluated before all other dimensions

values.asserted_doctrine: no marker present, declarative, speaker is the text's own prophetic or confessional voice
values.doxology_or_address: vocative_address marker, or the window is inside a hymn or prayer section heading
values.mythic_narration: mythic_narration marker, or the subject of the verb is a named divine agent acting in a story
values.conditional_hypothetical: conditional_hypothetical marker enclosing the divine claim
values.reported_speech_of_opponent: reported_speech marker with a human or opponent subject
values.polemic_denial: denial_of_other_gods marker aimed at a named rival
values.boast_of_non_divine_claimant: non_divine_speaker marker with a first-person divine formula
values.apophatic_negation: unknowable_or_conceptless in D1 with a negation; not yet implementable
values.doubt_or_inquiry: question marker with a seeking rather than rejecting frame
values.undecidable: default, and the expected common case; a coder who never lands here is not reading

D7_human_interpretation.known_unsolved: Section headings and verse numbers in the KJV and the Qur'an translation sit inside the same text stream as the content, so a 'chapter' heading can be read as narration. The windows must be built from the passage's `section_heading` field and the raw file's heading structure, not from sentence splitting alone.

self_declaration: This rule set is an analyst-authored candidate generator. Every value's `coverage_state` is published so that a missing value cannot be mistaken for a missing concept. `not_yet_instrumented` is not `absent`: the instrument reports three states and the third is the honest majority.
